gloss: to undertake, to accept, to take on

definitions.gloss: to undertake, to take on, to accept
definitions.explanation: To accept responsibility for a task, duty, or role.

definitions.gloss: to take charge of, to guarantee
definitions.explanation: To become responsible for someone or something.

examples.japanese: その{仕事|しごと}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた。
{彼|かれ}は{保証人|ほしょうにん}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}けてくれた。
examples.english: He agreed to be a guarantor for me.

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける{覚悟|かくご}がある。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: {引|ひ}く (to pull) + {受|う}ける (to receive)

CONJUGATION (ichidan): {引|ひ}き{受|う}ける → {引|ひ}き{受|う}けない → {引|ひ}き{受|う}けた → {引|ひ}き{受|う}けて

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {仕事|しごと}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける (take on work)
- {責任|せきにん}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける (take responsibility)
- {依頼|いらい}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける (accept a request)
- {役割|やくわり}を{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける (take on a role)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受|う}け{入|い}れる (to accept, receive)
- {担当|たんとう}する (to be in charge of)
